While memory costs are expected to easily dominate the iPhone 18 Pro bill of materials, the same might not be true for the iPhone Duo. Here are the details.

Apple signs three-year exclusive deal with Samsung Display

In a new Weibo post today, leaker Instant Digital claims that Apple has signed an exclusive three-year supply deal with Samsung Display for foldable panels.

According to the leaker, Samsung Display will be the exclusive supplier of foldable panels for the iPhone Duo "and its successors," with each panel costing around $250.

The leaker also points out that, unsurprisingly, this is "one of the most expensive core components" of the device.

Although there is no credible expected bill of materials report for the iPhone Duo yet, Apple has shared interesting information about the materials used in the device, including how much recycled content it contains, by breaking down the cost of the display, cameras, processor, memory, and other components.
